meta.title: Blueprint Studio
meta.description: Plan requirements, eight kinds of software-engineering diagram, version history and module subagents with the agent before coding; review, diff and dispatch from one studio.

title: Engineering blueprint
subtitle: Draw the system before you build it
emptyTitle: Turn a request into an engineering blueprint
emptyHint: Describe the task. The agent fills in requirements, use cases, data flow and modules; you refine them, then dispatch subagents per module.
emptyPlaceholder: e.g. Build a plugin marketplace for DSH with search, version pinning and one-click install…
noSelection: Select a node or edge to edit it.
noModules: No modules yet. Ask the agent to split the work into modules.
generating: The agent is drafting the blueprint…
expanding: The agent is expanding the blueprint…
promptSent: The agent will update the blueprint; this view refreshes automatically.
emptyDiagram: This diagram is empty. Add a node or ask the agent to expand it.
connectHint: Click a source node, then a target node.
confirmHint: One subagent per module, dependencies first.
canvasHint: Drag to pan · wheel to zoom · drag nodes to move
reviewHint: Accept writes the after value back to the current blueprint; reject keeps it unchanged.
reviewAcceptAllConfirm: Accept {count} review entries and write them to the current blueprint?
reviewRejectAllConfirm: Reject {count} review entries? The current blueprint stays unchanged.
reviewNeedsCurrent: Write-back is only available when the comparison target is Current. Restore a version or save as current first.
reviewUndoConfirm: Undo the last review write-back and save the blueprint again?
